topic: Spotlight on Dada, a veteran set makeup artist of 40 years
hook: He’s spent forty years painting the faces of Odia cinema’s gods and villains, yet his own face tells the most honest story.
cta: Next time you watch an old Odia classic, look past the actors for a moment. Look at the lines, the shadows, the sheer dedication of the crew behind them. Share this to celebrate our unsung veterans.
